AN ACT to amend the public housing law and the social services law, in
relation to conforming the definition of a veteran serving the Vietnam war
area to nearly enacted federal law (H.R. 7105) for veterans who served
in-country in the Republic of Vietnam from between February 28, 1961 and April
30, 1975, to any active duty service in the Republic of Vietnam that occurred

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S7124

SPONSOR: BROOKS
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the public housing law and the social services law, in
relation to conforming the definition of a veteran serving the Vietnam
war area to nearly enacted federal law (H.R. 7105) for veterans who
served in-country in the Republic of Vietnam from between February 28,
1961 and April 30, 1975, to any active duty service in the Republic of
Vietnam that occurred between November 1, 1955 and April 3, 1975

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This bill would change the beginning date of the Vietnam War from Febru-
ary 28, 1961, to coincide with the federal governments date.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends Section 156 of the Public Housing Law (Selection of
Tenants)to recognize any active duty service in the Republic of Vietnam
that occurred between November 1, 1955, and April 30, 1975 as wartime
era service.

Section 2 amends Section 68 of the Social Services Law (Veterans Assist-
ance) to recognize any active duty service in the Republic of Vietnam
that occurred between November 1, 1955 and April 30, 1975.

Section 3 is the enacting clause

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Public Law 116-515 recognizes the significant American military presence
in the Republic of Vietnam before February 28, 1961, the previous date
recognized by the federal government and the State of New York. To
ensure that the State of New York fully recognizes those men and women
who served in the Republic of Vietnam, several sections of law are
amended to be in sync with the federal recognition.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None noted.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately

SPONSOR: BROOKS
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the real property tax law, the executive law, the educa-
tion law, the public health law, the civil service law, the public offi-
cers law, the public housing law and the social services law, in
relation to conforming the definition of a veteran serving in the Viet-
nam war era to newly enacted federal law (H.R. 7105) for veterans who
served in-country in the Republic of Vietnam from between February 28,
1961 and May 7, 1975, to any active duty service in the Republic of
Vietnam that occurred between November 1, 1955 and May 7, 1975

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This bill would change the beginning date of the Vietnam War from Febru-
ary 28, 1961, to coincide with the federal governments date.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends section 458-a of the Real property Tax Law

(Alternative Veterans Real Property Tax Exemption) to recognize any
active duty service in the Republic of Vietnam that occurred between
November 1, 1955, and May 7, 1975 as wartime era service.

Section 2: amends Section 364 of the Executive Law (Blind Veterans Annu-
ity) to recognize any active duty service in the Republic of Vietnam
that occurred between November 1, 1955, and May 7, 1975 as wartime era
service.

Section 3: amends Section 668 of the Education Law (Regent Award for
Children of Veterans) to recognize any active duty service in the Repub-
lic of Vietnam that occurred between November 1, 1955, and May 7, 1975
as wartime era service.

Section 4 amends Section 668-c of the Education Law (Education Award for
Children of Vietnam Veterans Born with Spina Bifida) to recognize any
active duty service in the Republic of Vietnam that occurred between
November 1, 1955, and May 7, 1975 as wartime era service.

Section 5 amends Section 669-a of the Education Law (Veterans Tuition
Award) to recognize any active duty service in the Republic of Vietnam
that occurred between November 1. 1955, and May 7, 1975 as wartime era
service.

Section 6 amends Section 2632 of the Public Health Law (State Veterans
Homes) to recognize any active duty service in the Republic of Vietnam
that occurred between November 1, 1955, and May 7, 1975 as wartime era
veterans.

Section 7 amends Section 85 of the Civil Service Law (Extra Credits on
Civil Service Exams) to recognize any active duty service in the Repub-
lic of Vietnam that occurred between November 1, 1955, and May 7, 1975
as wartime era service.

Section 8 amends Section 63 of the Public Officer's Law (Leave of
Absence for Veterans on Memorial Day and Veterans Day) to recognize any
active duty service in the Republic of Vietnam that occurred between
November 1, 1955, and May 7, 1975 as wartime era service.

Section 9 amends Section 156 of the Public Housing Law (Selection of
Tenants) to recognize any active duty service in the Republic of Vietnam
that occurred between November 1, 1955, and May 7, 1975 as wartime era
service.

Section 10 amends Section 168 of the Social Services Law (Veterans
Assistance) to recognize any active duty service in the Republic of
Vietnam that occurred between November 1, 1955 and May 7, 1975.

Section 11 is the enacting clause.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Public Law 116-515 recognizes the significant American military presence
in the Republic of Vietnam before February 28, 1961, the previous date
recognized by the federal government and the State of New York. To
ensure that the State of New York fully recognizes those men and women
who served in the Republic of Vietnam, several sections of law are
amended to be in sync with the federal recognition.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New legislation.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None noted.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.
